questions.stem: This illustration shows the procedure essential for confirming ALL when blood counts are abnormal. In an adult, from which site is the needle most commonly inserted?

explanation.summary: Bone marrow biopsy/aspiration in adults is most safely and commonly performed at the posterior superior iliac crest to sample marrow for blasts.
explanation.whyCorrect: Bone marrow biopsy/aspiration in adults is most safely and commonly performed at the posterior superior iliac crest to sample marrow for blasts.

questions.stem: The left chest radiograph from a child with T-cell ALL differs from the normal film on the right at the arrow. What abnormality does the arrow indicate?

explanation.summary: T-cell ALL commonly presents with an anterior mediastinal mass from lymphadenopathy, seen here as widening/opacity absent on the normal comparison film.
explanation.whyCorrect: T-cell ALL commonly presents with an anterior mediastinal mass from lymphadenopathy, seen here as widening/opacity absent on the normal comparison film.
